summary.text: Joey Marschall is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Kevin Krentz in a race with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in customer service.

paragraphs.text: Joey Marschall was born in Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, earned a high school diploma from Fond du Lac High School and attended the University of Wisconsin, Oshkosh, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey completed for a campaign for Wisconsin's 6th Congressional District, he said he was born and raised in Fond du Lac and lives in Waushara County.
Marschall advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for Assembly District 57 with 99.8 percent of the vote in an uncontested race.
Ballotpedia also lists him as a 2026 candidate for the U.S. House in Wisconsin's 6th District, but he did not appear on the ballot in that district's August 11, 2026 Democratic primary.
In that survey he named healthcare, human rights, veterans, labor unions and foreign policy as the policy areas he is passionate about.
